result.note: Tests the partner country in the RBI payments MoU and what the MoU covers; India's earlier UPI links are used only as context.

questions.prompt: As reported in June 2026, the Reserve Bank of India signed a Memorandum of Understanding to connect its digital payment systems with which country's central bank?
questions.explain: The RBI signed the MoU with the State Bank of Vietnam to link the two countries' digital payment systems. India has been extending its Unified Payments Interface one country at a time, with links already running or agreed across Singapore, the UAE, France and Sri Lanka.
questions.source: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) and the State Bank of Vietnam have signed an agreement to connect their digital payment systems.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the India–Vietnam digital payments MoU reported in June 2026:
items: It covers information sharing and regulatory coordination between the two sides.
It was signed by the National Payments Corporation of India and the State Bank of Vietnam.
It provides for cross-border QR-code merchant payments.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the MoU was signed by the Reserve Bank of India and the State Bank of Vietnam. New Delhi presents the tie-up as a way to make trade and tourism payments faster, cheaper and real-time.
questions.source: The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) covers information sharing, regulatory coordination, and the plumbing for cross-border QR-code merchant payments.
